concept: Ecology and Functions of an ecosystem
question: Which of the following is an example of an artificial ecosystem?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aquariums**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Artificial ecosystems:-**

 
 
• These are ecosystems that are created and maintained by humans.
 
• They are not self-sustaining, meaning that they require human intervention to survive.
 
• Examples of artificial ecosystems:
 
 
• **Aquariums (Hence option 1 is correct)**
 
• **Zoos**
 
• **Botanical gardens**
 
• **Greenhouses**
 
• **Farms**
 
• **Cities**
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Grasslands:-**

 
 
• **These are areas where the vegetation is dominated by grasses. **
 
• They are found on all continents except Antarctica and cover about 40% of the Earth's land surface.
 
• Grasslands are characterized by their open, treeless landscapes and their diverse plant and animal life. 
 
 
 
• **Desert:-**
 
 
• **A desert is a region of land that receives very little precipitation. **
 
• Deserts are found on all continents except Antarctica and cover about one-third of the Earth's land surface. 
 
 
 
• **Coral reefs:-**
 
 
• **These are underwater ecosystems made up of tiny living organisms called coral polyps. **
 
• Coral polyps are related to jellyfish and anemones. They live in colonies and secrete a hard limestone skeleton that builds up over time to form coral reefs.
